where.screen_path: Settings → Fresh → Quick share (preset catalog + share-card modal); /verify (URL ?p=<base64url> ingestion for one-tap verify); existing /entry/:digest → Share a proof (Fresh 'View as share card' button)

what.summary: Shipped Fresh roadmap Cut 7: the 9:16 screenshot-targeted share card (assertion + Bitcoin block stamp + verifier URL on aurora-drift background), the Quick-share preset catalog under Settings → Fresh (verified-profile + one membership preset per held credential), the QuickShareModal that mints multi-disclosure proofs and base64url-encodes for inline /verify?p=<bundle> URLs under a 1.8KB cap, and the VerifyProofScreen URL-parameter ingestion that auto-pastes-and-verifies a tapped share-card link. ShareProofModal gained a Fresh-only 'View as share card →' button that opens the same modal with an adhoc preset matching the operator's manual leaf selection. One commit (322a40d), all four gates green, bundle budgets clean.

why.text: Cut 7 of the 2026-05-24 Fresh young-adult-friendly theme + IA roadmap. The brief framed the share card as the audience's actual distribution channel — sovereignty spreads not because people read white papers but because someone screenshots a one-tap credential that worked at a door and the receiver taps the link and watches math validate in green. Compose-first onboarding (Cut 5) argued the operator's life is the substrate; share cards argue the operator's reputation is propagatable. Brief listed four presets but only two have data — operator picked the smallest correct slice and deferred over-N presets to a future identity-model cut rather than change the founding identity shape mid-pilot.

outcome.notes: [P-CUT-7] ✓ ShareCard 9:16 visual treatment (pure presentation, no business logic) (commit 322a40d). QuickShareModal mints proof + computes inline-URL with 1.8KB cap fallback to plain /verify. QuickShareSection Settings preset catalog Fresh-gated, lazy-loads modal. VerifyProofScreen accepts ?p=<base64url>, auto-pastes-and-verifies. ShareProofModal Fresh-only 'View as share card →' opens modal with adhoc preset matching manual selection. quickSharePresets.ts enumerator reuses isMembership from connections feature so catalog stays in lockstep with People-tab recognition. Brief-vs-code mismatch on over-18/over-21 presets surfaced BEFORE coding; operator decision logged. All four gates green: typecheck ✓ / lint ✓ / 48 tests ✓ / build ✓. Bundle budgets clean: QuickShareModal lazy chunk 2.11KB gz under 3KB catch-all, SettingsScreen 9.85KB gz under 10KB, login bundle unchanged at 11.11KB gz under 12KB. Keys-never-leave audit: no new code path logs, persists, or transmits a key, seed, or passphrase; disclosure bundles only reveal leaves the operator explicitly selected. [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: surfacing brief-vs-code mismatches before coding via AskUserQuestion worked well — the operator chose the right slice in one round and Cut 7 landed clean in one session.
